lead_raw_text:
The structure of TiNi2Ge2O7 (Ti2Ni4Ge4O14) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ge centers in tetrahedral environments with four O neighbors, while Ni centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors. The Ge tetrahedra share corners with one another, and corner- and face-sharing links the Ge tetrahedra to Ni-centered 12-vertex polyhedra. The neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 24 sites.
